headline: Severe Cyclone Arnab: Thousands evacuated in India as storm intensifies
summary: The very severe cyclonic storm is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh by Wednesday morning, bringing heavy rain and strong winds.
details: Thousands of people have been evacuated along India's eastern coast as Cyclone Arnab grows into a very severe cyclonic storm. The storm formed over the Bay of Bengal and has intensified significantly since Monday.
In Andhra Pradesh, nearly 50,000 people have been moved to shelters from vulnerable areas, with an estimated 400,000 people potentially needing evacuation.
The storm is expected to make landfall in the southern coastal state of Andhra Pradesh by Wednesday morning, bringing intense showers and strong winds to Andhra Pradesh and neighboring Odisha.
In Odisha, schools and colleges in five districts have been closed for Tuesday and Wednesday as a precautionary measure.
Transportation has been heavily impacted, with at least 12 trains cancelled in the east and rail services on 53 routes along the southern coast suspended for two days.
Nepal has also issued warnings for tourists in high-altitude areas due to fears that the storm could trigger torrential downpours, snowstorms, and avalanches in the Himalayan region.
This comes as Nepal recovers from deadly flash floods in August that killed approximately 1,500 people.

headline: Grid fault causes power outage in parts of Dhaka and Chattogram
summary: A technical glitch in the power grid disrupted electricity supply to several areas in the two major cities, with restoration efforts underway.
details: A technical glitch has suspended the power supply to several areas of Dhaka and Chattogram on Tuesday.
According to a notice from the Power Division, emergency work is currently underway to restore electricity to the affected regions.
The Power Division confirmed that connections have already been restored in most areas.
Officials expect the power supply to be fully restored in the remaining affected areas in a very short time.
caption:
Power outage hits parts of Dhaka and Chattogram due to a grid fault.

A technical glitch has suspended the power supply to several areas of Dhaka and Chattogram on Tuesday.

According to a notice from the Power Division, emergency work is currently underway to restore electricity to the affected regions.

The Power Division confirmed that connections have already been restored in most areas.

Officials expect the power supply to be fully restored in the remaining affected areas in a very short time.
